notes: Items on belts no longer pile on top of each other.
The main menu shows one of four factories at random.
Your best daily time is kept even if you close the tab right after winning.
The daily game keeps your best time.
New: save a finished factory and look at it again from the main menu.
Every building is on the bar at once.
Dragging a pipe now follows the pointer.
Forges and mixers need just 1 ore.
Forges and mixers show the color of what they hold.
Items keep their lane going into the exit.
Fixed the notch in the cut buttons.
A busier factory behind the main menu.
Dragging a building other than a belt or pipe now follows the pointer.
A factory now runs behind the main menu.
Pumps and stampers show their work more clearly.
Splitters, underground belts, pumps, stampers and pipes now animate.
Mixed-color ore and lakes now sit on the normal floor.
New: Daily game, the same map and recipe for everyone each day.
Hover over ore or a lake to see its color.
Online players on an older version are asked to reload.
The room code stays on one line in the lobby.
The game has a tab icon.
A game clock next to the recipe.
The lobby has a Copy code button.
Hover works while you hold a building.
Every map has ore.
Clicking a machine while holding a building opens its panel.
Fixed the tutorial stalling at the cutter step.
Hover shows liquids in pumps, forges and pipes.
Esc on the Solo game screen goes back to the main menu.
Fixed the game clock running fast.
Fixed Rematch showing the last game's recipe.
The HUD no longer hides the bottom of the map.
You can zoom out further.
Hold Alt to see each cutter's cut and the color on each drill and pump.
Hovering a stamper shows its pieces.
Fixed the stamper's output facing the wrong way.
New: a tutorial on the main menu.
One Forge now makes plates from ore, liquid or paste.
The exit is bigger and easier to find.
Clearer ghosts, with arrows for where each building takes and drops.
Machine panels show how much each input holds.
Pipes show the color of their liquid.
Items follow the curve of belt turns.
New: Settings, with volume, edge pan and your own hotbar.
Hold Tab or click the recipe to see it large.
Machines move while they work.
Belts, splitters and underground belts can be placed over belts.
Online players can pick a name.
Belt and pipe drags stay on one row or column.
Machine panels have an OK button.
A new cutter waits until you pick a cut.
Inserters swing their arms.
Drags build as you go, and one undo takes back a whole drag.
Holding an underground belt or pipe shows how far it reaches.
A pump touching a machine fills it without a pipe.
New: online games. Host, then share the link or the room code.
Q picks up the building under the pointer, even with something in hand.
Fixed edge pan stopping over the HUD.
Fixed pipes not looking joined to pumps and machines.
Drag to place, and right-drag to remove.
Undo, redo, box select, and copy and paste.
Sounds for your building actions.
Hover over an item to see it up close.
First version: solo games, with a choice of difficulty and map size.
